statement: NVIDIA's CFO said the revenue opportunity per gigawatt of AI data-center capacity rises to about $40 billion with Vera Rubin, up from $25 billion with Blackwell and roughly $18 billion before.
why: This is the clearest statement of how much NVIDIA content sits inside each gigawatt built, and it is rising fast generation over generation.

impact.mechanism: A higher revenue-per-gigawatt figure means each unit of new power capacity converts into materially more NVIDIA data-center revenue, raising the revenue ceiling for a given buildout pace.

evidence.source: Investing.com earnings call transcript (NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings call)
evidence.excerpt: our revenue opportunity has grown from roughly $18 billion per gigawatt to $25 billion with Blackwell, to $40 billion with Vera Rubin.

confidence.basis: Third-party transcript of an official earnings call rather than a filed document; the underlying event is anchored to NVIDIA's 8-K of the same date, but the quoted figure was not verified against the primary filing text.

dispersion: Roughly $18B per gigawatt historically, $25B with Grace Blackwell, $40B with Vera Rubin.
